headline: Exchange Inflow Falls To 186.0 Million Dollars From 406.6 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues fell to a 186.0 million dollar net inflow, 0.0688 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from a 406.6 million dollar net inflow at 0.1502 percent. Bitstamp took in 120.1 million dollars and Bybit took in 99.1 million dollars, while Bitget shed 64.4 million dollars, OKX shed 61.1 million dollars, and Bitfinex went from a 135.0 million dollar intake to a 1.8 million dollar outflow. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, so a positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell and a negative print means dollars left those venues.
author: jordan
